title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent's memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and $\tau^2$-bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on $\tau^2$-bench. translated_title: ARISE：面向准确且高性价比企业智能体的实用自进化记忆架构
translated_abstract: 企业级 LLM 智能体运行在动态环境中：基础模型快速演进、工作流频繁更新，且部署需要同时满足准确性与成本要求。我们提出 ARISE（Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation，通过迭代自我评估实现智能体精炼），这是一种实用的记忆架构，使智能体的记忆能够从自身的失败中进化，而无需更新模型权重、工具或工作流逻辑。ARISE 利用模型本身或教师模型对失败进行归因并提出修正；随后，ARISE 将这些修正保存为可检索的微观记忆，并将其整合为宏观规则，且只有在留出集准确率提升时才接受规则更新。在使用 5 个模型、覆盖来自 SOP-Bench 和 τ²-bench 的 14 个企业工作流领域的实验中，采用 Claude Opus 4.6 进行归因与整合的 ARISE-Teacher 在 SOP-Bench 上较基线提升 10.9 个百分点，在 τ²-bench 上提升 5.8 个百分点；此外，ARISE-Teacher 还比 GEPA 高出 4.5 个百分点（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: ARISE 提出了一种无需更新模型权重、工具或工作流逻辑的智能体记忆自进化架构，通过迭代自我评估对失败进行归因并生成修正，将其沉淀为可检索的微观记忆并整合为宏观规则（仅当留出集准确率提升时才采纳），在 14 个企业工作流基准上显著提升准确率并兼顾成本。
en_tdlr: ARISE is a practical self-evolving memory architecture that enables enterprise agents to learn from their own failures—using self- or teacher-model attribution to store retrievable micro-memories and consolidate them into macro rules only when held-out accuracy improves—achieving significant accuracy gains (10.9 pp on SOP-Bench, 5.8 pp on τ²-bench) without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic.
